freeze_rule: Inherited from v1.0.0: ANY instrument edit produces a new version string; old measurements stand unchanged. v1.0.0 and its measurements are preserved byte-identical (proven by the equivalence re-runs below).
change_log_v1_0_0_to_v1_1_0: MECHANISM_STARVED boundary (Art. LXXXIV, enforced engine-side since R514): transitions 6-9 (attack/contradiction/experiment/mutation) on a starved run keep their raw bytes as diagnostic extras but report reached=False with the new MECHANISM_STARVED drop reason. Non-starved rows are byte-identical to v1.0.0 modulo the version string and the additive starvation_terminal marker.

STAGE_ORDER working copy updated to the 15-stage executable chain (MULTI_SOURCE_DISCOVERY retired R513; IMPROVE linear placeholder retired R515). Tie-breaking only (pick_work_envelope); never counting.

Transition 9 byte source UNCHANGED: the post-rank kill point still records through env.run_stage('IMPROVE'), so kill-point stage_log IMPROVE entries read exactly as v1.0.0 read them. The retired linear DEFERRED_TO_KILL_POINT entry simply stops appearing on new runs (old rows keep reading it).
Reason vocabulary: v1.0.0 frozen set + MECHANISM_STARVED (new version carries it).
what_it_measures: Whether the machine DISCOVERS, not whether it completes. Funnel rows are computed from each run's own durable bytes only — never self-reported values, never narratives, never summaries (Art. XXIV). The instrument is observational and never writes to the run directory it reads (Art. IX). v1.1.0 additionally reports the starvation terminal consistently (Art. LXXXIV/LXXXIII) instead of letting later downstream artifacts read as independently reached scientific transitions.

funnel_transitions.name: evidence_verified
funnel_transitions.note: the run's own typed verification issues (e.g. missing_source_span, mechanism_span_not_verbatim) are carried in verification_issues

funnel_transitions.name: candidates_generated_distinct
funnel_transitions.count_rule: DISTINCT only; INDETERMINATE counted separately and never as invention (Art. XLII: INDETERMINATE is a legitimate verdict, not DISTINCT); grid-advanced counts never counted (LXXVIII)

funnel_transitions.name: attack_survivors
funnel_transitions.count_rule: the primary candidate's gauntlet outcome; SURVIVOR_SELECTION.ranked non-killed entries are recorded as grid_advanced_not_counted, NEVER as survivors
funnel_transitions.starvation_note: on a MECHANISM_STARVED run the attack never executed (R514 gate): reached=False with MECHANISM_STARVED (never the ATTACK_KILLED mislabel v1.0.0 emitted for absent attack bytes)

funnel_transitions.name: contradiction_survivors
funnel_transitions.byte_source: contradictions.blocking_count (the engine's own ADJUDICATION no_blocking_contradictions definition)
funnel_transitions.count_rule: survivor iff blocking_count == 0 AND the run is not MECHANISM_STARVED (an empty queue on a starved run is diagnostic bytes, never a survived transition)

funnel_transitions.name: experimentally_discriminated
funnel_transitions.count_rule: SELECTED is not EXECUTED; v1.1.0 counts EXECUTED only via the Art. XXXVIII REAL_LOOP_VERIFIED byte state (inherited); on a MECHANISM_STARVED run selection bytes are diagnostic-only regardless

funnel_transitions.name: mutated_survivors
funnel_transitions.byte_source: stage_log IMPROVE entries: status==CHILDREN_ADMITTED + entry-level delta_real + ledger{children_admitted, children_rekilled, loop_closure} + EVOLUTION_GEN_1.json (the post-rank kill point records through env.run_stage('IMPROVE') — unchanged by the R515 linear-slot retirement)
funnel_transitions.count_rule: children admitted AND delta_real true AND re-evaluated AND the run is not MECHANISM_STARVED (even admitted children on a starved run are diagnostic bytes, never discovery evidence)

funnel_transitions.name: buyer_ready
funnel_transitions.byte_source: DISCOVERY_RELEASE.json status + package_zip + loop_verification_state + real_loop_verified + INVENTION_LINEAGE.survivor_reached
funnel_transitions.count_rule: ZIP emitted AND release in RELEASED/SHIPPED/TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY; HELD_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW is a typed drop carrying failure_reason

mid_flight_rule: A run directory without run_manifest.json is MID_FLIGHT_OR_PARTIAL_PER_LXXIV — an observation, never a terminal (the R487/R489 terminal-divergence ruling). Terminal and mid-flight rows are never collapsed in aggregates.
honesty_pins: NOVELTY_LEFT_UNRESOLVED_BY_RING_FAILURES: collision mandatory_searches.complete=false is carried on every row; novelty is never resolved from failed searches (Art. XXI.3, LXXV.2)
cost/debits typed UNKNOWN_PER_ART_XXV when no metered cost bytes exist in the run records — never invented
attacker_provenance typed on every attack_survivors transition
declared_family ABSENT_IN_DURABLE_RECORD when problem.json carries no canonical_family (the R489 submission-path gap, disclosed)
STARVATION_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: on a MECHANISM_STARVED run, transitions 6-9 carry epistemic_use DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_NOT_DISCOVERY_EVIDENCE — raw bytes preserved, never counted (Art. LXXXIV)

battery_requirements_from_directive.problems: 6-10 blind fresh problems, >=3 families, corpus-disjoint against R446/R412/R458/R492-DEV/sealed corpora (test-enforced), family-declared at submission
battery_requirements_from_directive.rules: pinned healthy ring, committed driver only, zero human bytes, freeze gates + instrument for the battery duration, NO mid-battery fixes, all attempts published incl. zeros
battery_requirements_from_directive.void_rule: a battery with re-tuned gates mid-run is void
battery_requirements_from_directive.reproducibility: a second container re-runs the yield computation from the same durable bytes and must reproduce the funnel exactly
